title: Inter at San Siro tonight — four with Italy, one with France
caption:
Inter shouldn't lend San Siro to Italy — but tonight they do. Four Inter men are in the Italy squad to face France and one, Andy Diouf, is with France, per Inter.it. And per Gazzetta dello Sport via Football Italia, Marcus Thuram's tests showed no tear.
